meta.name: ux-design
meta.description: Design and review user experience for any product surface: web pages, mobile screens, desktop windows, game HUD and menus, CLI prompts, voice interfaces, AI-agent chat surfaces, and onboarding flows. Produces UX specs with information architecture, interaction patterns, screen states (empty, loading, error, success), micro-copy guidelines, design-system tokens, and acceptance criteria the implementation can ship against. Use after platform-detector and before architecture-review or service-implementation on any feature with a user-facing surface, and as a recurring polish gate before release.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 梳理产品各界面交互体验,产出发版可用的设计规范
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的产品上线前需要系统打磨各端体验。
copy.tagline_en: Turn any product surface into launch-ready UX specs.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically refine user experiences before launch.

howto.what: 当你让它设计或评审某个产品界面时,它会产出一份完整的用户体验规格书,写明页面结构、各种屏幕状态(空白、加载、出错、成功)、交互方式、文案语气、设计规范和验收标准。
howto.when: 当你为一个面向用户的界面(网页、App、游戏界面等)做设计或评审时,在平台检测之后、架构评审或开发之前触发;也会在发布前作为打磨检查触发。

say.text: 帮我设计这个网页的用户体验
say.note: 会产出一份包含所有屏幕状态的UX规格书。

say.text: 评审这个App界面的交互和文案
say.note: 会检查状态是否齐全、是否符合平台规范。

say.text: 为这个功能写UX规格书并列出验收标准
say.note: 会生成可供测试的验收清单。

howto.what_en: When asked to design or review a product surface, it outputs a UX spec naming content hierarchy, every screen state (empty/loading/error/success), interaction patterns, micro-copy style, design-system tokens, and acceptance criteria.
howto.when_en: Triggered for any feature with a user-facing surface, after platform-detector and before architecture-review or service-implementation; also as a recurring polish gate before release.

say_en.text: Help me design the UX for this webpage.
say_en.note: Produces a UX spec with all screen states.

say_en.text: Review this app interface's interactions and copy.
Write a UX spec for this feature with acceptance criteria.
